card.title: The Callback Changes Meaning
card.instruction: Treat every returning phrase or action as evidence the relationship has changed. Repeat it with a new emotional meaning each time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Anything for you.' That's what I said when you asked for a lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now could we collect my piano?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you was much lighter five minutes ago.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the piano you learned on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anything for you. But you're carrying the end with the memories.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recalls generous anything-for-you, A3 repeats it as strain and A5 returns it with affection after shared piano history.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 piano expands the lift and causes A3 weight complaint; B4 learned-on instrument causes A5 renewed help.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks an enlarged favor and B4 reveals why the object matters to A too.

heightening.evidence: B4 shared past changes A5 willingness while leaving a comic division of physical and emotional weight.

specificity.evidence: A1 lift request and B2 piano pickup establish the favor expansion clearly.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 end with memories earns the metaphor from B4 exact learning history.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 asks to expand the lift remembered at A1 into piano collection.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 gives the piano a shared personal significance.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 repeats the phrase with renewed commitment after B4 and assigns B the memory-heavy end.
